notes: Parts are the same as in step 1; nothing added or dropped.
The parts list says 82 ohm but the schematic labels the resistor 220 ohm. I kept 82 ohm from the parts list.
Circuit: pin 2 -> green wire -> resistor -> LED anode; LED cathode -> black wire -> GND. The resistor is on the anode side, as in the schematic.

Breadboard holes were read from the image: resistor in columns 3 and 6, LED anode (bent leg) in column 6, LED cathode in column 8. Both wires and the LED sit in the top half of the board, which is named 't' in the catalogue.
The board's pin 2 is the catalogue port D2.
The USB cable plugs into the board's USB port and only powers and programs the board.
